title: Eventual Hom vanishing for varying shifted heart objects under Brown compactness
statement: Let X be a scheme and Λ a commutative condensed coefficient ring. Put S=Dctf(X,Λ) and L=Loc(S) [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Assume BrownHypothesesFor Λ X [lem-sfb-brown-hypotheses-criterion]. Let K belong to L and have underlying object in S. For every sequence F_n of module objects over Λ_X with F_n[0] in L, there is a natural N such that Hom(K,F_n[0][n])=0 for every n≥N. Shifts and Hom groups in the conclusion are ambient; no uniformity or constructibility of the F_n is assumed.

source.place: finite-support argument in not_preservesColimitsOfShape_of_forall_hom_ne_zero, generalized using DegreewiseLimits.lean, HomologicalComplex.isLimitFanMkProjOfIsColimit

proof.text: Set M_n=F_n[0][n]. If its degree-d term is nonzero, d+n=0, so its degree supports are disjoint. Shift closure and the canonical shift comparison of Q put each Q(M_n) in L. Apply the finite-support theorem for degreewise disjoint complexes.

Take N one greater than the maximum exceptional natural index. For n at least N the Hom group to Q(M_n) is a subsingleton. Compose a given map to F_n[0][n] with the inverse canonical comparison, make it zero by subsingleton elimination, and cancel the comparison isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem BrownHypothesesFor.eventually_hom_single_shift_eq_zero
    {Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X : Scheme.{u}} (hB : BrownHypothesesFor Λ X)
    (K : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory)
    (hK : constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X K.obj ∧
      DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K.obj)
    (F : ℕ → Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hF : ∀ n, localizingClosureProEtale Λ X
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (F n))) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, ∀ f : K.obj ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (F n))⟦(n : ℤ)⟧, f = 0
